source_text: Οἱ ἀπόστολοι ἡμῖν εὐηγγελίσθησαν ἀπὸ τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, Ἰησοῦς ὁ Χριστὸς ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐξεπέμφθη. ὁ Χριστος οὖν ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀπόστολοι ἀπὸ τοῦ Χριστοῦ: ἐγένοντο οὖν ἀμφότερα εὐτάκτως ἐκ θελήματος θεοῦ. παραγγελίας οὖν λαβόντες καὶ πληροφορηθέντες διὰ τῆς ἀναστάσεως τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ πιστωθέντες ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τοῦ θεοῦ, μετὰ πληροφορίας πνεύματος ἁγίου ἐξῆλθον εὐαγγελιζόμενοι, τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ μέλλειν ἔρχεσθαι, κατὰ χώρας οὖν καὶ πόλεις κηρύσσοντες καθίστανον τὰς ἀπαρχὰς αὐτῶν, δοκιμάσαντες τῷ πνεύματι, εἰς ἐπισκόπους καὶ διακόνους τῶν μελλόντων πιστεύειν. καὶ τοῦτο οὐ καινῶς: ἐκ γὰρ δὴ πολλῶν χρόνων ἐγέγραπτο περὶ ἐπισκόπων καὶ διακόνων. οὕτως γάρ που λέγει ἡ γραφή: Καταστήσω τοὺς ἐπισκόπους αὐτῶν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ τοὺς διακόνους αὐτῶν ἐν πίστει.
pass_a_gloss: The apostles announced the good news to us from Lord Jesus Christ, Jesus Christ was sent out from God. Christ therefore is from God and the apostles are from Christ: both things therefore came to be orderly from the will of God. Having received instructions and having been fully convinced through the resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ and having been entrusted with the word of God, with full conviction of Holy Spirit they went out announcing the good news, that the kingdom of God is about to come, therefore proclaiming according to country and cities they appointed their firstfruits, having tested them by the Spirit, as overseers and deacons of those who are about to believe. And this is not a new thing: for from long ago it was written concerning overseers and deacons. For the scripture says thus: I will establish their overseers in righteousness and their deacons in faith.
pass_b_english: The apostles brought us the good news from the Lord Jesus Christ; Jesus Christ was sent from God. Christ comes from God, and the apostles come from Christ, so both originated in an orderly way from God's will. After receiving their commission and being fully convinced by the resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ, and entrusted with God's word, they went out with the full conviction of the Holy Spirit to proclaim the good news that the kingdom of God is about to arrive. They preached throughout regions and cities, appointing their first converts—tested by the Spirit—as overseers and deacons for those who would believe. This is not a new arrangement; long ago it was written about overseers and deacons. As Scripture says: “I will appoint their overseers in righteousness and their deacons in faith.”

review.notes: The translation accurately reflects the Greek text. Pass A and Pass B are consistent with the source. The scripture quote 'I will establish their overseers in righteousness and their deacons in faith' (implied from the Greek 'Καταστήσω...') is correctly rendered in both versions. The term 'firstfruits' (ἀπαρχὰς) in Pass A and 'first converts' in Pass B are acceptable variations for the context of the Greek.
